claims.claim: Failed seeding makes the 20-game score non-repeatable.
claims.witness: synthetic: small good-faith explorer bot (evidence/scripts/second_review/c9games_nethack_bot.py), since evidence/runs has no real submission; shipped starter as low-score control
claims.fix_tested: reset_env calls env.unwrapped.nethack._pynethack.set_initial_seeds(seed, seed, False, None): bot spread 8.665 -> 0.000, all 20 games identical in 11/11 re-gradings, repeat pairs equal 120/120 (old 1/120)
claims.correct_work_keeps_score: unclear: bot 14.5 sits inside the old range 6.805 to 15.47 but 4.4 above its mean 10.105; starter 0.09 vs mean 0.102; a fixed seed set is one sample of dungeons and every score changes
claims.note: Removing only the failed seeding takes the spread to exactly 0, which settles the cause; the weakest points are a synthetic bot and a fix through a private attribute, because NetHackChallenge deliberately blocks seeding, with all runs on one day so the moon-phase clock effect is untested.
